FAOSTAT Indicators

## Cleaning FAOSTAT Dataset
faostat_meta <- read.csv(file.path(input_dir, "FAOSTAT_iso3c_conversion_sheet.csv")) |>
  select(Area.Code..ISO3., Area) |>
  unique()

faostat_pre1 <- read.csv(file.path(input_dir, "Production_Crops_Livestock_E_Africa.csv"))
faostat_pre2 <- read.csv(file.path(input_dir, "Production_Crops_Livestock_E_All_Area_Groups.csv"))

faostat <- faostat_pre1 |>
  bind_rows(faostat_pre2) |>
  filter(Area %in% faostat_meta$Area) |>
  left_join(faostat_meta, by = "Area") |>
  select(-c(Area.Code, Area.Code..M49., Item.Code..CPC., Element.Code),
         -ends_with("F"),
         -ends_with("N")) |>
  rename_with(~ gsub("^Y", "", .x), starts_with("Y")) |>
  rename("iso3c" = Area.Code..ISO3.) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = "1961":"2024",
               names_to = "date",
               values_to = "value") |>
  mutate(date = as.numeric(date)) |>
  mutate(highlight = (Area == "Togo"))



## Creating viz for cereal yield and growth
faostat_cereal_yield <- faostat |>
  filter(iso3c %in% afw_codes,
         Item.Code == "1717",
         Element == "Yield",
         date >= 2000)

faostat_cereal_yield_plot <- faostat_cereal_yield |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = value, group = Area, color = highlight)) +
  geom_line() +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#0071BC", "FALSE" = "#8A969F"),
                     labels = c("TRUE" = "Togo", "FALSE" = "Africa West and Central")) +
  labs(
    title = "Cereal Yield, kg/ha",
    x = "",
    y = "",
    color = "") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(min(faostat$date), max(faostat$date), by = 5))
faostat_cereal_yield_plot

faostat_cereal_yield_growth_plot <- faostat_cereal_yield |>
  group_by(Area) |>
  summarize(
    start_year = min(date),
    end_year = max(date),
    start_value = value[which.min(date)],
    end_value = value[which.max(date)],
    diff = end_value - start_value,
    pct_change = (end_value - start_value) / start_value * 100,
    highlight = first(highlight),
    .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(Area = fct_reorder(Area, pct_change)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Area, y = pct_change, fill = highlight)) +
  geom_col() +
  theme_minimal() +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#0071BC", "FALSE" = "#8A969F"),
                     labels = c("TRUE" = "Togo", "FALSE" = "Africa West and Central")) +
  labs(
    title = "Cereal Yield Growth from 2000-2024, percent",
    x = "",
    y = "",
    color = "") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
faostat_cereal_yield_growth_plot
## Ignoring unknown labels:

## Creating viz for cereal production per capita

  filter(iso3c %in% afw_codes,

  left_join(country_pops, by = c("iso3c", "date")) |>

## Loading in FAOSTAT Food Security Indicators
faostat_food_import <- read.csv(file.path(input_dir, "FAOSTAT_food_import_pct_aggregates.csv")) |>
  select(Area.Code..ISO3., Area, Item, Year, Value) |>
  mutate(year_start = as.numeric(str_extract(Year, "^\\d{4}")),
         label = if_else(Year == max(Year), as.character(Area), NA_character_),
         highlight = (Area.Code..ISO3. == "TGO")) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year_start, y = Value, group = Area, color = highlight)) +
  geom_line() +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#0071BC", "FALSE" = "#8A969F"),
                     labels = c("TRUE" = "Togo", "FALSE" = "Africa West and Central")) +
  labs(
    title = "Value of food imports in total merchandise exports (percent)",
    x = "",
    y = "",
    color = "") +
  geom_label_repel(aes(label = label),
                   nudge_x = 0.5,
                   direction = "y",
                   hjust = 0.5,
                   segment.color = NA,
                   na.rm = TRUE) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

faostat_food_import

faostat_prod_indicies_pre1 <- read.csv(file.path(input_dir, "Production_Indices_E_Africa.csv")) |>
  left_join(faostat_meta, by = "Area") |>
  filter(Area.Code..ISO3. %in% afw_codes)
faostat_prod_indicies_pre2 <- read.csv(file.path(input_dir, "Production_Indices_E_All_Area_Groups.csv")) |>
  filter(Area %in% c("World", "Africa", "Western Africa")) |>
  mutate(aggregate = TRUE)

faostat_prod_indicies <- faostat_prod_indicies_pre1 |>
  bind_rows(faostat_prod_indicies_pre2) |>
  select(-c(Area.Code, Area.Code..M49., Area.Code..ISO3., Item.Code..CPC.),
         -ends_with("F"),
         -ends_with("N")) |>
  rename_with(~ gsub("^Y", "", .x), starts_with("Y")) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = "1961":"2024",
               names_to = "date",
               values_to = "value") |>
  mutate(date = as.numeric(date)) |>
  mutate(highlight = (Area == "Togo"))


agri_index_aggs_plot <- faostat_prod_indicies |>
  filter(Item == "Agriculture",
         aggregate == TRUE | highlight == TRUE,
         Element.Code == "432",
         date >= 2000) |>
  mutate(label = if_else(date == max(date), as.character(Area), NA_character_)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = value, group = Area, color = highlight)) +
  geom_line() +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#0071BC", "FALSE" = "#8A969F"),
                     labels = c("TRUE" = "Togo", "FALSE" = "Africa West and Central")) +
  labs(
    title = "Gross Production Index Number (2014-2016 = 100)",
    x = "",
    y = "",
    color = "") +
  geom_label_repel(aes(label = label),
                   nudge_x = 0.5,
                   direction = "y",
                   hjust = 0.5,
                   segment.color = NA,
                   na.rm = TRUE) +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2000, max(faostat_prod_indicies$date), by = 5))
agri_index_aggs_plot
